text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Called to the waiting room by Gold Ship, I walk inside to find her trembling from head to toe.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's just a routine. It's a surefire way to make sure I'm fired up and in top condition.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: See? The people next door always get mad at me when I do this. I'll leave the apologies to you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm in the zone! Golshi, heading out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship races out of the room before I can reply, so I have no choice but to go next door and apologize. At least she's in top form today.
